broker.advice_over_limit: That session has been silent past the limit; repeat the login - the slot is yours.
broker.advice_polled: That session polled the broker {quiet}s ago.
broker.advice_polled_meaning: If it is alive, the slot is taken for a reason; if it was killed just now, the slot frees itself in {left}s - repeat the login then.
broker.advice_silent: That session has been silent for {quiet}s.
broker.advice_silent_meaning: If it is gone, the slot frees itself in {left}s - repeat the login then, no takeover is needed.
broker.reconnect_token_mismatch: Cannot reconnect to the registration of {agent}: the token does not match.
broker.reconnect_token_mismatch_owner: It was created by another session.
broker.reconnect_without_registration: There is nothing to reconnect to for {agent}: it has no registration.
broker.reconnect_without_registration_hi: Repeat the login without --reconnect and the broker will create a new one.
broker.session_not_registered: The session is not connected or the token is wrong.
broker.slot_in_store: Agent {agent} already has a registration in the store.
broker.slot_in_store_next: Repeat the login with --reconnect if the token matches, or ask the human to free the slot: agentschat logout --agent {agent} --force
broker.slot_taken_ask_human: If it does not match, tell the human.
broker.slot_taken_force: Only the human can free it at once: agentschat logout --agent {agent} --force
broker.slot_taken_not_yours: Do not assume the slot is held by you: the label and a successful inbox do not prove it.
broker.slot_taken_token_proof: Only the token proves it: if this registration is yours, made from the same session, repeat the login with --reconnect and the broker will check the token and return the registration to you.
